title: Swamp Villages
body:
**What this Datapack adds ➕**:
 - This is a simply datapack that adds swamp villages.

**Installation Guide** (_only if not want it to be on a modrinth profile_) 📥:
 -  1.Go to the "More" Tab
 -  2.Press "Data Packs" button
 -  3.Press "Open Pack Folder"
 -  4.Put the Datapack in the folder that just opened
 -  5.Close the opened folder
 -  6.Put the datapack in the selected section by pressing the arrow button that appear when you hover the mouse over it
 -  7.Enjoy!
 
**Compatibily ✅**:
 - I don't know if i works with Dungeons and Taverns datapack but you can try
